title: Sometimes I forget how blessed I am 🤍
description:
I remember when living in New York was just something I daydreamed about.
And now I'm living it.

Life here is still hard. Loud, expensive, exhausting some weeks. But lately I've been reminding myself of the things I overlook.

I have a roof over my head.
There's food on my plate, sometimes more than enough.
I have people who love me and show up for me.
And a healthy body that lets me walk this city and climb a wall after work.

Life isn't perfect. But it's a lot. 🤍

#gratitude #nyclife #blessed #selfgrowth #lifeinyour20s
